meta.title: Daybreak Overture - Angelus' Message
meta.description: We continue on toward hope because we have never forgotten their deaths.

units.rawText: Thanks to the efforts of both you and Dr. Persica, the Reverse Babylon Tower has been re-established, and I thank you on behalf of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Thanks to the efforts of both you and Dr. Persica, the Reverse Babylon Tower has been re-established, and I thank you on behalf of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Thanks to the efforts of both you and Dr. Persica, the Reverse Babylon Tower has been re-established, and I thank you on behalf of the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Professor, you have indeed protected us as agreed upon. You have our gratitude for your efforts.
units.displayText: Professor, you have indeed protected us as agreed upon. You have our gratitude for your efforts.

spans.text: Professor, you have indeed protected us as agreed upon. You have our gratitude for your efforts.

units.rawText: If you ever find yourself with free time, the Reverse Babylon Tower's doors are always open to you. We shall treat you as a most esteemed guest of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: If you ever find yourself with free time, the Reverse Babylon Tower's doors are always open to you. We shall treat you as a most esteemed guest of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: If you ever find yourself with free time, the Reverse Babylon Tower's doors are always open to you. We shall treat you as a most esteemed guest of the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: I cannot take the credit for it all. Magrasea's future has been forged by everyone with their own hands.
units.displayText: I cannot take the credit for it all. Magrasea's future has been forged by everyone with their own hands.

spans.text: I cannot take the credit for it all. Magrasea's future has been forged by everyone with their own hands.

units.rawText: That much is true. Your influence, however, has been of utmost importance and cannot be understated.
units.displayText: That much is true. Your influence, however, has been of utmost importance and cannot be understated.

spans.text: That much is true. Your influence, however, has been of utmost importance and cannot be understated.

units.rawText: Professor, might you be free? I want to show you around Magrasea... so that you can see this world you've protected with your own eyes.
units.displayText: Professor, might you be free? I want to show you around Magrasea... so that you can see this world you've protected with your own eyes.

spans.text: Professor, might you be free? I want to show you around Magrasea... so that you can see this world you've protected with your own eyes.

units.rawText: Could we take the scenic route? I have his favorite wine and flowers.
units.displayText: Could we take the scenic route? I have his favorite wine and flowers.

spans.text: Could we take the scenic route? I have his favorite wine and flowers.

units.rawText: ...Of course. I am sure Lord Hesperus would be elated to know that you still hold him in your heart.
units.displayText: ...Of course. I am sure Lord Hesperus would be elated to know that you still hold him in your heart.
